description:
Create a draft in Mail's Drafts mailbox. The draft is the END of this tool's reach: sending is a human action in Mail.app. Account is required — the writing identity is never guessed.
[governed: scope=Mail mode=write-safe undo=compensate]

replyToMessageId.description: Draft a reply to this Message-ID; recipient and subject derive from it

subject.description: Required unless replying (reply keeps Re: subject)

name: mail_create_draft
